title: 第230章 白衣渡江第229章 掌劫渡业仙尊
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
这个世界没有第二块大陆。
陆地的尽头是海，海的尽头大概率还是海。
岛屿散落在广袤的洋面上，大的约有人类王国的十分之一大小，小的只够站下一座灯塔。
岛上原住民也大多不是严格意义上的人类，住着长着兽耳与尾鳍，与王国内地的类似种族被统一划分为“兽人”，他们在密林与礁石间繁衍出自己的部族语言与大多为血腥祭祀的原始信仰。
信仰是教会最不能容忍的东西。
教会视这些“异教”为必须“引回正途”的迷途羔羊。
每隔数年便有圣殿骑士团与传教修士乘船渡海，在岛屿上建立小型教堂与哨站，以圣光术治愈疾病、以谷物铁器换取信任，同时压制部落祭司的祭祀活动。
久而久之，许多岛屿的兽人逐渐接受了教会的教义，部落的原始祭坛被改为圣光礼拜堂。
由于王国对跨海治理缺乏兴趣，也无力维持远洋舰队，海外诸岛实际上的行政、司法与军事权力几乎全数落入教会之手。
岛上的领主若想稳固统治，往往需要先取得教会驻岛主教的认可。
在这片海洋上，圣光的权威远胜王冠。
换言之，勇者身为教会的代表，在那些岛屿上的地位可谓相当超然。
……
乐天派的莉莉丝吃完果子后不久就不生窝囊气了，将注意力转移到了钓鱼上。
已经彻底摆脱了晕船阴影的莉莉丝自诩钓鱼高手，此刻正盘腿坐在船艏的木箱上，手里攥着一根从厨房顺来的细绳。
绳头系着一小块风干肉，有一下没一下地往水面垂放，试图引诱某条不长眼的飞鱼上钩。
季天站在船舷边，正将那张海图重新卷好。
他确认过了，按照现在的航速，明日傍晚前应当能抵达南境群岛的外围，伊芙琳说的那座“大帽子岛”也在那个方向上。
就在这时，船艏右侧约莫两百尺外的海面上，传来一声沙哑的呼喊。
“救命——！有没有人——！救命——！”

声音断断续续，带着被海水呛过的沙哑，似乎是已经喊了很久，快没力气了。
莉莉丝猛地抬头，手里的细绳一松，风干肉无声落入海面。
“呱！我的鱼饵！不对，师傅！那边有人！”
她顺着声音的方向指去，约两百尺外的海面上，确实有道身影正趴在一块半沉的浮木上。
那人穿着件湿透的深灰色短袍，衣摆在水面上漂散开，头发散乱地贴在脸上，看起来已经被海水泡了很久，浮木上还绑着几只空水囊——典型的商人打扮。
他看见海雀号上的莉莉丝注意到了自己，像是抓住了最后一根稻草，用尽全力朝这边挥手：
“救命！我是商船‘白鹭号’的管事，我们被海盗劫了！船沉了，就剩我一个人！”
莉莉丝转头看向季天和船长，“要救他吗？”
伊芙琳站在舵轮旁，目光在那道身影上停了一会儿，“勇者大人，这种人多半是骗子，商船被劫后落水的人不会喊得这么有中气。”
她说着，朝那方向扬了扬下巴：“喂——那边那位！我这边是精灵王庭的船，你确定要我救你吗？”
content_en:
There is no second continent in this world.
The end of the land is the sea, and the end of the sea is most likely still the sea.
Islands are scattered across the vast ocean. The largest ones are about one-tenth the size of the human kingdom, and the smallest ones are only big enough to stand on a lighthouse.
Most of the indigenous people on the island are not humans in the strict sense. They live with animal ears and tail fins. Similar races in the kingdom are uniformly classified as "orcs". They have developed their own tribal language and primitive beliefs that mostly involve bloody sacrifices among the dense forests and rocks.
Faith is the last thing the church can tolerate.
The church views these "heretics" as lost sheep who must be "led back to the right path."
Every few years, the Knights Templar and missionary monks would cross the sea by boat and establish small churches and outposts on the islands. They would use holy light to cure diseases, exchange grain and iron tools for trust, and at the same time suppress the sacrificial activities of tribal priests.
Over time, the orcs on many islands gradually accepted the church's teachings, and the tribe's original altar was changed to the Holy Light Chapel.
Due to the kingdom's lack of interest in cross-sea governance and its inability to maintain an ocean-going fleet, the actual administrative, judicial and military power of the overseas islands fell almost entirely into the hands of the church.
If the lords on the island want to stabilize their rule, they often need to obtain the approval of the church's bishop on the island.
On this ocean, the authority of the Holy Light is far greater than that of the Crown.
In other words, as the representative of the church, the brave man's status on those islands can be described as quite transcendent.
…
The optimist Lilith stopped feeling cowardly soon after eating the fruit and turned her attention to fishing.
Lilith, who has completely gotten rid of the shadow of seasickness and considers herself a fishing expert, is sitting cross-legged on the wooden box at the bow of the ship, holding a string that came from the kitchen in her hand.
A small piece of air-dried meat was tied to the end of the rope, and it was lowered to the water surface every now and then, trying to lure a flying fish with no eyes to take the bait.
Ji Tian stood on the side of the ship and was rerolling the chart.
He had confirmed that according to the current speed, he should be able to reach the outskirts of the Southern Islands before tomorrow evening. The "Big Hat Island" Evelin mentioned was also in that direction.
At this moment, a hoarse cry came from the sea about two hundred feet away on the right side of the bow.
"Help—! Is there anyone—! Help—!"
His voice was intermittent and hoarse as if he had been choked by the sea water. It seemed that he had been shouting for a long time and was almost running out of energy.
Lilith raised her head suddenly, the string in her hand loosened, and the dried meat fell silently into the sea.
"Quack! My bait! No, master! There is someone over there!"
She pointed in the direction of the sound, and there was indeed a figure lying on a half-sunk piece of driftwood on the sea about two hundred feet away.
The man was wearing a soaked dark gray short robe. The hem of the clothes was floating on the water, and his hair was messy on his face. He looked like he had been soaked in the sea water for a long time. There were also several empty water bladders tied to the driftwood - a typical businessman's attire.
He saw Lilith on the Puffin notice him, as if grasping the last straw, waving in this direction with all her strength:
"Help! I am the steward of the merchant ship "Egret". We were robbed by pirates! The ship sank and I am the only one left!"
Lilith turned to look at Ji Tian and the captain, "Do you want to save him?"
Evelin stood by the steering wheel, her gaze resting on that figure for a while, "Sir Brave, most of these people are liars. People who fell into the water after a merchant ship was robbed would not scream so confidently."
She said, raising her chin in that direction: "Hey - that guy over there! This is the ship of the Elf King's Court. Are you sure you want me to save you?"
